# Direct recursive enum seed

An owned carrier, method and platform Enum each retain their independent Enum<Self> bound. A direct enum value binds the method result carrier without replacing the provider result, casts or effects. Owned SDK EnumSet.of calls preserve the single seed, null failures and the runtime enum family, including constant-specific subclasses.

Six frozen routes compare 96 JVM cases twice against source and dependency-provider recovery. Twenty wrong programs and six Code-preserving Signature controls exercise observer sensitivity, independent scope ownership, recursive constraints, result slots and call roles. No private application code executes.
